definitions.full: H4831. Maralah מַרְעֲלָה proper name, of a location on border of Zebulun Josh 19:1 . ᵐ5 Μαραγελδα , A Μαριλα , ᵐ5 L Μαραλα . מַרְמֵּה מַרְמֵּא, see רפא . [ מִרְמָּשׂ ] see רפשׂ .

occurrences.englishText: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
